title: Fixed small typo in by_row docs & roxygenised them
Split method for grouped dataframes
description:
I frequently find myself wanting to create a list from a grouped dataframe using the base R `split` function. This method is derived from some of the work from [this tweet](https://twitter.com/coolbutuseless/status/970250159400484865) about problems using the base split function on grouped dataframes and helps in situations where `tidyr::nest` is kind of awkward. It also helps with some of the `do` use cases by allowing this workflow: 

```
mtcars %>%
  group_by(cyl, wt) %>%
  split() %>%
  map_df(my_function)
```

You can still access the base split behaviour by supplying additional arguments to the method. I'm not sure that `purrlyr` is the best place for this, but thought I would start a PR to find out.
